sources.title: Investigation into BT following voice service interconnect outages on 24 and 25 July 2025
sources.geo: United Kingdom BT and EE interconnect services
facts: The investigation concerns a software issue affecting voice interconnection on 24 and 25 July 2025.
The case references telecoms-security duties under the Communications Act and 2022 regulations.
limits: The investigation remains open and is not a final determination.
The incident record is not current coverage evidence.

sources.title: Ofcom fines Vonage £700,000 for emergency call failures
sources.geo: United Kingdom Vonage business VoIP customers
facts: Ofcom fined Vonage £700,000 for emergency-call failures.
The affected period ran from 23 October to 3 November 2023.
limits: The decision concerns a defined provider and incident.
It does not measure general broadband reliability.

sources.title: Network security
facts: The index links Ofcom's network-security and resilience work.
It lists provider guidance and regulatory updates.
limits: An index is source-lineage evidence rather than a compliance finding.
Linked materials have different dates and scopes.

sources.title: Guidance for communications providers and operators of essential services
sources.geo: United Kingdom communications providers and essential-service operators
facts: The page links Ofcom policy and security guidance for regulated operators.
It references Ofcom duties under the amended Communications Act.
limits: The page does not prove any operator's compliance.
PDF guidance internals were not used.

sources.title: Our network security and network resilience work
facts: Ofcom has additional telecoms-security duties and powers under the amended Communications Act.
The page describes cooperation on telecoms network resilience.
limits: A work-programme overview is not an audit result.
It does not establish service at a premises.

sources.title: Statement: Network and Service Resilience Guidance
facts: Ofcom published updated resilience guidance on 16 June 2026.
The work considered power resilience and network availability.
limits: The HTML statement is not the full guidance text.
Guidance does not prove compliance or local availability.

sources.title: Ofcom launches 2026 wholesale telecoms review to power-up gigabit broadband rollout
sources.geo: United Kingdom fixed wholesale telecoms markets
facts: The review covers regulation for April 2026 to March 2031.
The launch page reports national aggregate gigabit and full-fibre availability at its publication date.
limits: Wholesale regulation does not prove parcel orderability.

sources.publisher: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
sources.title: Revised Telecommunications Security Code of Practice 2026 (version 1.1)
facts: The government published a revised Telecommunications Security Code of Practice in 2026.
The publication follows consultation on updates to the code.
limits: The landing page is not an operator compliance assessment.
Individual duties depend on the legal framework and provider tier.

sources.publisher: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
sources.title: Draft Revised Telecommunications Security Code of Practice
facts: The page describes a risk-based security framework for public telecoms networks and services.
It links the framework to the Telecommunications (Security) Act reforms.
limits: The title retains 'draft' wording within the publication collection.
The code is not evidence of a provider's actual controls.
